subject: High-throughput accelerant request — POC load run
messages:
From: Sam Kline <sam.kline@beaconai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: qa+load@beaconai.com
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: High-throughput accelerant request — POC load run

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. We're planning a 48–72h overnight soak next week to validate tail-latency under sustained QPS for the Beacon recommendation model. The run will spike to ~3.5k RPS for 6–12 hr windows and then settle to a 1.5k baseline.

Short ask: can Redwood provision an ephemeral credit top-up (or temporary quota bump) to cover the expected token volume and burst testing? We estimate ~2.2M tokens across the run. Attached is our load plan and a short traffic waveform.

Schedule preference: start the evening of Tue Apr 12 (PST) and run through Wed Apr 13. If we can get confirmation by EOD Mon, we'll lock the run and route telemetry to the team.

Questions we expect to surface:
- Any model variant you recommend to keep latency under 150ms p95 during the 3.5k RPS spikes?
- Is there a preferred way to configure batching or prefix caching for this workload with Redwood Dedicated?

Attaching: beacon-load-plan.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to confirmation.

—Sam
Sam Kline
Senior SRE, BeaconAI
sam.kline@beaconai.com
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Kline <sam.kline@beaconai.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High-throughput accelerant request — POC load run

Sam —

Appreciate the detail and the load plan. We can support this run but need to provision a provisional top-up and route through internal approvals (sales ops + finance) because the expected token burn is outside the default trial envelope.

What I can do immediately:
- Provision a provisional 48h accelerant credit bucket to cover the first 24–48h so you can start the soak on Tue evening. This would be time-limited and monitored.
- Camila will advise on the best model/quantization profile and batching knobs to minimize tail-latency.

Action items for you: please confirm the exact start time (PST) and whether you'll require streaming responses (we'll need to size sockets). Also confirm whether the run will hit embedding/parallel-embedding endpoints — that affects the estimate.

I've attached a quick internal checklist to capture approvals. We'll follow up with a formal quote for the top-up so finance can sign off.

Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com

Attachment referenced: estimated-topup-quote.csv
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High-throughput accelerant request — POC load run

Irene / Camila —

Thanks for looping me in. I reviewed Sam's load waveform and the attached numbers. I'm comfortable authorizing a provisional 48h top-up to cover up to 2.5M tokens for this POC, contingent on finance approval of the estimated top-up quote. I've noted DEAL-202704-BEACON on the request so it ties back to the pipeline.

Two notes from SE perspective:
- Use the gpt-mid-q8s model variant for the high-QPS windows; it keeps inference stable at higher concurrencies while reducing memory pressure.
- Enable continuous KV caching and set max_batch_delay to 8ms for best throughput/latency trade-off. Camila will validate these values in staging prior to the window.

Marissa — can you fast-track the quote so we can get finance sign-off? I'll mark this as high-priority for onboarding.
